s1.syndrome_frame: Multiple skin-colored papules on the face and vulva with a gradual increase in number over time
salient_findings: Multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored asymptomatic papules on the face and vulva
Family history of similar facial papules
Histopathology showing buds and cords of basaloid cells enclosing small cystic spaces
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 60s
Lesions first appeared around 50 years of age
Approximately 60 lesions are present
Lesions are located on the face and vulva
No palmar or plantar pits were observed
Patient has a history of meningioma
Family history of similar facial papules
Histopathology of lesions shows basaloid cells and small cystic spaces
Whole-exome sequencing revealed a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of multiple dome-shaped, skin-colored papules on the face and vulva, along with a history of meningioma and a family history of similar lesions, is consistent with Nevoid Basal Cell Carcinoma Syndrome. The histopathology showing basaloid cells and small cystic spaces, as well as the whole-exome sequencing revealing a conserved splice-site mutation in the SUFU gene, further supports this diagnosis.
